snippet.title: Kingdoms of Harad Launch Trailer - The Lord of the Rings Online
snippet.description:
The Kingdoms of Harad stand at a crossroads, their rivalries sharpening as a greater threat gathers strength. Gandalf has come with a warning of a darkness rising in the South. The Thardúth, ancient servants of Morgoth, rise once more, harnessing powers that could unmake the balance of Middle-earth.

Rally the Kindred of the Coins along with the fierce Mizâdi, Shâra of Renewed Hamât, as rival kingdoms clash and old grudges resurface. From arid wastelands, blighted forests, and perilous ruins, war looms on every horizon. Who will rise to lead the Kingdoms of Harad against the coming darkness, or deeper into it?
 
The Kingdoms of Harad expansion is live. Come back to LOTRO with new quests, regions, and an increased level 160 cap!
 
Play The Lord of the Rings Online for free: https://www.lotro.com
Get Kingdoms of Harad: https://www.lotro.com/kingdoms-of-harad
